subject: Twitter authentication was applied in R but still R Shiny is giving Auth error.

messages.author: 9ca9ebb97d13ef3d
messages.subject: Twitter authentication was applied in R but still R Shiny is giving Auth error.
parts:
After few hours of work, I am giving up with Shiny..

I applied Twitter authorization code and I am still getting “Error:OAuth authentication required with Twitter API v1.1”.
I followed these steps and apply the PIN in R shiny server:
requestURL <- "https://api.twitter.com/oauth/request_token"
accessURL = "https://api.twitter.com/oauth/access_token"
authURL = "https://api.twitter.com/oauth/authorize"
consumerKey = "————"
consumerSecret = "———–"
twitCred <- OAuthFactory$new(consumerKey=consumerKey,
consumerSecret=consumerSecret,
requestURL=requestURL,
accessURL=accessURL,
authURL=authURL)
download.file(url="http://curl.haxx.se/ca/cacert.pem",
destfile="cacert.pem")
twitCred$handshake(cainfo="cacert.pem")

I see the pin number and apply the pin number in R server (installed R and Shiny on same server)

messages.author: 4f04313c0a6b0f2f
messages.subject: Re: Twitter authentication was applied in R but still R Shiny is giving Auth error.
parts: It might be a good idea to get the twitter authorization credential outside of the shiny environment to make sure it's working by testing if you can retrieve tweets. You can then save the credential file. Once that's done, it's relatively smooth. I have a couple of twitter related apps using the shiny server application. However, they don't detail the process of getting the credentials. You can find more details at http://analyticsandvisualization.blogspot.com
